reply.text: I'll pull up the coaching record for your deadlift so I can give you the right cues. I don't have any logged deadlifts yet, so I can't see what's happening with your setup. The key things: your shoulders should sit directly over the bar at the start, not in front of it. Your chest stays up, knees bend until your shins touch the bar — not a squat, the hips come second. When you drive up, it's legs first, then lock out the hips at the top. Where does it feel off — the bottom, the pull, or the lockout?
